recap.narration_text: Time for a quick review of learner license and companion rules. A learner license earned at fifteen is Class D with a Y restriction, and before sixteen the companion must be a licensed Alabama driver at least twenty-one or an instructor. From sixteen any licensed driver may ride beside the learner; the license issued at fifteen lasts four years and renews once, and a learner license can be suspended or revoked. Keep these ideas handy as you practice.

hooks_spoken: Drivers sixteen to under eighteen hold the learner license six months or until eighteen before the road test, and passing drops the Y restriction for the rest of the same term.
Class M with a B restriction covers small motor driven cycles at fourteen or fifteen, full Class M covers motorcycles from sixteen, and vessel licenses start at twelve.
